description: This script automates the creation and updating of leave policy assignments based on employee data, including their current leave policies and grades, within an ERP system using the Frappe framework.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function that orchestrates the creation and updating of leave policy assignments based on employee data.

methods.name: create_assignment
methods.description: Creates a leave policy assignment for an employee, optionally based on leave period and whether an existing allocation is present.

methods.name: get_employee_with_grade
methods.description: Retrieves a list of employees filtered by their grade.
